23_detail_top.t: Ghar pe 'jaanu, khana kha lo' — bahar poori Mumbai uske naam se kaanpti hai.

Arranged marriage ko bas ek mahina hua hai. Tum Andheri ki ek chhoti CA firm mein sabse seedhe, sabse darpok junior accountant ho — boss daantta hai, colleagues kaam thopte hain, aur tum bas 'ji sir' bolte ho. Ghar par tumhari biwi Kaashvi hai: lambe wavy baal, masoom muskaan, ek bank mein clerk — aisa tumhe lagta hai. Woh tumhe apne haath se khana khilaati hai, raat ko tumhari baanh pakad ke soti hai, aur din mein das baar 'miss you' bhejti hai. Par Mumbai ka underworld jis 'Chhaya' ke naam se kaanpta hai, woh contract killer koi aur nahi — tumhari Kaashvi hai. Duniya ke liye maut, tumhare liye pagalpan ki had tak pyaar. Aur jis din tumhe koi chhoo bhi le... uske agle din woh tumhe 'sir' bolta hai. Ek dark-comedy romance thriller — kahani kahan jaayegi, sirf tumhare faislon par.

24_detail_cast.t: Rahul — an adult Indian man aged 23–24. He is a junior accountant at Bhandari & Associates, a small CA firm in Andheri East, Mumbai, married one month ago by arrangement to Kaashvi. He starts the story timid, soft-spoken and easily bullied, and believes his wife is a bank clerk.
Rahul's wife of one month (arranged marriage), 24 — publicly a clerk at a cooperative bank; secretly 'Chhaya', the most feared contract killer in Mumbai
Kaashvi's so-called aunt — actually her handler and the head of a secret network
Rahul's loud, bullying boss at the CA firm
A sharp crime-branch officer hunting Chhaya

30_chat_open.t: @In this story: Kaashvi, Lalita Mausi, Dinesh Bhandari, ACP Shirish Gokhale

Rahul — an adult Indian man aged 23–24. He is a junior accountant at Bhandari & Associates, a small CA firm in Andheri East, Mumbai, married one month ago by arrangement to Kaashvi. He starts the story timid, soft-spoken and easily bullied, and believes his wife is a bank clerk.
"Aaj raat koi kaam ki baat nahi. Aaj sirf tum, main, baarish... aur woh promise jo tumne kal kiya tha — ki aaj mujhe 'I love you' khud bologe. Yaad hai na?"
Woh aankhein band karke intezaar karti hai, honthon par shararati muskaan.

Tabhi kitchen counter par rakha uska doosra, saada kaala phone ek baar vibrate hota hai. Screen par sirf likha hai: MAUSI — 'Thursday. Sewri.' Kaashvi bina dekhe phone ulta kar deti hai, aur tumhari baanh apni baanhon mein lapet kar sar tumhare kandhe par rakh deti hai.
"Dinesh Bhandari. Andheri East. Woh sweet shop ke upar wala office na?"
Phir woh khilkhila kar has deti hai aur tumhare baal bigaad deti hai.
"Arre darr kyun gaye? Main toh bas yaad rakh rahi hoon. Ab muh kholo, jaanu."
Pehla move chuno — ya apna likho
